title: rustle app.json
description: Optional metadata at the top of a rustle package. See SPEC.md, section 4.

format.description: Package format version. Absent means 1. A host refuses a format newer than it supports.

title.description: Name shown in the app list.

description.description: One or two sentences shown under the title.

page.description: Path of the app's own page inside the package. Without it the host looks for index.html, then demo/index.html, www/index.html and web/index.html.
